title: PlannerState
description: Schema v1.1 per ADR-0048 (2026-09-09). recommended_route promoted from optional to required field. Consumed by rdd-builder P0 dispatch-quick decision.

state_revision.description: Wave 4 Sub-task 0.0: increments when semantic content changes (excluding last_sync_at/last_sync_status/sprint_started_at/state_revision/recommended_route itself).

previous_unmapped.description: Unmapped proposal names captured at the previous sync (additive v1).

recommended_route.description: REQUIRED per ADR-0048 (2026-09-09) §Decision 2. Planner advisory signal consumed by rdd-builder P0 dispatch-quick decision. Heuristic: simple if all active_projects for this change have priority=P3 AND file_count<=2 AND no public-interface change keyword; complex if priority in {P0,P1} OR touches _lib/core/_lib/schemas/ OR breaking-change keyword; unknown otherwise. Not authoritative — rdd-builder P0 retains HARD pause user override.
